extract_zip_archive: extract a zip archive to an output directory with SHA256 digest verification and prefix stripping
extract_tar_gz_archive: extract a tar.gz archive to an output directory with progress printing every 100 files
iterate_zip_entries: iterate over entries in a zip file yielding FileEntry objects for each non-directory file
iterate_tar_entries: iterate over entries in a tar file yielding FileEntry and SymlinkEntry objects for files and symlinks
checked_join_path: safely join an output directory with a relative path ensuring the result stays under the output directory
